findings.note: Denver is without All-Pro CB Patrick Surtain II and S Talanoa Hufanga, and CB Riley Moss is questionable. Seattle WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba and DT Leonard Williams have no game status, so both are cleared to play.

Seattle's team site says Denver's injured secondary could push Seattle to lean on its passing game. That offense is led by Smith-Njigba, who leads the NFL in receiving yards and TDs, though Denver's defense is still described as one of the league's best.

Both teams are 3-2 and Denver is 2-0 at home this season. Separately, ESPN reports Seattle will be without starting LB Drake Thomas (Tyrice Knight starts) and RB Zach Charbonnet. No analyst picks on the spread showed up in the search.
